issues.description: Return-type mismatch for the PersonResource.getAllPersons() endpoint: the template declares ResponseEntity<List<Person>> while the solution declares ResponseEntity<Set<Person>> but returns personService.getAll() (which is a List). This inconsistency across template and solution is likely accidental and will confuse students (and may cause a compile error in the solution).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent. Either change the solution's PersonResource.getAllPersons() signature to ResponseEntity<List<Person>> (and keep returning personService.getAll()), or change PersonService.getAll() to return a Set<Person> and adapt usages accordingly. The simplest fix: update the solution method signature to ResponseEntity<List<Person>> and ensure imports reflect java.util.List.
